description: This file defines the IReminderService interface in C# for managing grain reminders within the Orleans framework. It includes method signatures for starting, stopping, registering, unregistering, and retrieving reminders associated with grains.

classes.name: IReminderService
classes.description: Interface for managing reminders in Orleans, providing methods to start, stop, register, unregister, and retrieve reminders.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers a new reminder or updates an existing one for a specific grain.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reminder registered to a grain by name.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Retrieves all reminders registered for a specific grain.
